about: Pipeline alert items flagged for a known reason. A matched item is listed under its reason in the pipeline alert digest and never notifies. On the review date it comes back as needing a look: recheck, then move the date or remove the entry. `match` takes item ids, with * for any run of characters. Read by digest() in rolling-alert.js.

entries.reason: JJM login wall: since 20 Oct JJM answers the identity step's state postback with its OTP login page, so the directory refresh cannot run.
The Satara Atlas refresh stopped on 2 Oct at the JJM validate step (1,740 of 1,742 villages read); a contributor has it.
HMWSSB has published nothing newer than 17 Oct; the laptop job's scrape runs clean (logs 20-22 Oct), so the gap is upstream.
India-WRIS groundwater has served no reading after 4 Jun (found 30 Sep); the endpoint answers with an empty result.
Season closed: build_basin_rainfall.py has normals for 1 Jun - 31 Aug only and refuses a later cutoff.

KWRIS has not changed since the 18 Jul ingest: on 23 Oct all 8 sub-basin groundwater values matched the scoreboard. A full re-ingest would overwrite the water-quality and river-stretch post-steps and the rainfall deviation, which cannot be rebuilt until June.
